title: BELT ROUTING
summary: Accessory drive belt routing (fan belts) for the 454 big-block engine: base, LJ2, N40 power steering, LJ2 with N40, C60 air conditioning (with idler pulley), and C60 with N40. A.I.R. smog pump, P/S pump and A/C compressor belts are shown on their tracks; tension specs are on the 350 sheet (A4).
notes: NOTE: For belt tensioning specifications, see "350" Engine Belt Routing Sheet.
A = 1ST TRACK, B = 2ND TRACK, C = 3RD TRACK (crankshaft pulley groove).
notes_internal: Diagram page: no part callouts. Table lists the pulleys and belt letters in each layout; exact belt paths on the 454 drawings cross and overlap, so per-belt pulley lists are not recorded.
Base 454: A drawn between crankshaft and water pump, B from crankshaft to generator (letters reversed versus the 350 sheet).
Circled (1) revision marks sit at belt A in the RPO C60 and RPO C60 WITH RPO N40 drawings.
Rev 1 text: count before PLACES unreadable (probably the two circled spots), written '?'.
Title block: DR WO/C1, CK 4-18-69 C1, PREL 3-28-69, C/O A6 (sic); model box 19000 ("454" ENGINE). Sideways 'K186'.
